missing_info: Full unfiltered output of `uv python list` (the pasted listing shows only installed interpreters, no download entries)
Output of `uv python list --all-versions` or `uv python list cpython-3.14` on the reporter's machine
Whether the uv binary is native x86_64 or running under Rosetta 2 (uname -m / file $(which uv))
Contents of the uv configuration file that sets python-downloads = "manual" and any UV_PYTHON_* environment variables
rationale: The reporter's template says bug and the core complaint (3.14.8 absent from `uv python list` while `uv python install 3.14.8` succeeds on the same platform) is inconsistent with the documented behaviour that the listing shows the latest patch of available downloads, so it reads as a real defect, though the pasted output shows installed interpreters only and cannot prove the download entry was missing. The `uv python install 3` / `install 3.14` 'already installed' result is documented behaviour (uv verifies an existing managed install and does not upgrade patch versions), so that part is not a bug on its own. Searching issues found no matching duplicate. Docs (python-versions.md) say available Python versions are frozen per uv release and python-downloads=manual only restricts downloads to `uv python install`. A full listing and the architecture/config details are needed before a maintainer can reproduce.
